the use of multi-sensors and the application of advanced image analysis techniques are fundamental to obtain detailed and accurate data that can be used in the development of hazard assessment models.

optical multi-sensors, such as SPOT/6/7 and EO-1 ALIs, can be successfully used for monitoring volcanic activity in remote areas, and the availability of high-quality data allows for the generation of reliable maps and digital elevation models.
